mapper.insert: insert into a2a_state_history( tenant_id,history_id,a2a_request_id,from_status,from_operational_stage,to_status,to_operational_stage, blocker_code,transition_command,required_permission,evidence_type,evidence_reference,domain_event_code,failure_handling, timeout_policy,expected_version,resulting_version,recovery,reason_code,reason,actor_type,actor_id, correlation_id,transition_at,request_version,idempotency_key ) values( #{entry.tenantId},#{entry.historyId},#{entry.requestId},#{entry.fromStatus},#{entry.fromOperationalStage}, #{entry.toStatus},#{entry.toOperationalStage},#{entry.blockerCode},#{entry.transitionCommand}, #{entry.requiredPermission},#{entry.evidenceType},#{entry.evidenceReference},#{entry.domainEventCode},#{entry.failureHandling}, #{entry.timeoutPolicy},#{entry.expectedVersion},#{entry.resultingVersion},#{entry.recovery}, #{entry.reasonCode},#{entry.reason},#{entry.actorType},#{entry.actorId},#{entry.correlationId}, coalesce(#{entry.transitionAt},now()),#{entry.requestVersion},#{entry.idempotencyKey} ) on conflict(tenant_id,idempotency_key) where idempotency_key is not null do nothing
mapper.select: select * from a2a_state_history where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
select * from a2a_state_history where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_request_id=#{requestId} order by transition_at asc limit #{limit}
